subjects.name: Arin
subjects.description: Man with dark curly hair and a beard, a red and navy plaid shirt, dark jeans, brown boots and a canvas satchel on his right shoulder

place.description: A sunlit stone courtyard: a black iron railing in front of an open arcade of stone pillars and arches along a pale plaster wall, a shaded walkway under the arches, olive trees in terracotta pots, a worn stone floor.

shots.description: Arin keeps walking from left to right along the railing in the same side-view tracking shot, framing and light.
shots.screen_direction: Screen left to screen right, as before.
shots.sound: Footsteps on stone, a light breeze in the olive leaves; the sound continues across the cut.

shots.description: Arin keeps walking at the same steady pace, mid-stride as the shot begins. A closer medium shot from the same side of the courtyard: the camera stands on the open paving close to his path, level with him, and tracks along with him; he fills the frame from the waist up, seen in profile. Camera position: On the open paving, much closer to his path than before, on the same side as the previous shot. The black iron railing, the arcade columns and the pale wall stand behind him.
shots.screen_direction: He still moves from screen left to screen right.
shots.sound: Footsteps on stone, a light breeze in the olive leaves; the sound continues across the cut.
